description: This file defines the ClientEntity class implementing the ClientEntityInterface for OAuth2, including methods for setting and getting client properties such as name and redirect URI.

classes.name: ClientEntity
classes.description: Entity class representing an OAuth2 client, implementing ClientEntityInterface with properties for name, redirect URI, and confidentiality.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the OAuth2 client.

methods.name: setRedirectUri
methods.description: Sets the redirect URI for the OAuth2 client.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the OAuth2 client.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Retrieves the redirect URI of the OAuth2 client.

methods.name: setIsConfidential
methods.description: Sets whether the client is confidential.
